messages.content: 白俄政府应急部门客户原有的网络部署是什么？
DMR常规网络部署
如何获取Smart MDM服务器的地址信息？
Smart MDM服务器地址包括IP地址和端口号，需联系Smart MDM服务器管理员获取。
如何配置TETRA终端的本机号码、国家码和网络码？请给出具体配置路径。
本机号码的配置路径为：TMO移动管理 -> 移动设置 -> 本机号码；国家码和网络码的配置路径为：TMO移动管理 -> 网络列表 -> 网络名称、国家码、网络码。
What are the two methods available for installing Smart MDM?
Smart MDM can be installed by either installing the Smart MDM server on a Third-Party server or by using the cloud Smart MDM server provided by Hytera.
What is the required deployment order for the server and Smart MDM to prevent potential errors?
Deploy the server before installing Smart MDM. If Smart MDM has already been installed, it must be uninstalled first.
Which packages must be uploaded to the /home directory on the Linux server using the root user via FTP?
The packages "MDMServer.tar.gz", "sql", "mdm_shell", and "yum_mdm.tar.gz" must be uploaded to the "/home" directory.
How should the dependency package installation commands differ when the system is CentOS 7.9 compared to the default procedure?

For CentOS 7.9, use 'tar -zxvf yum_mdm7.9.tar.gz' instead of 'tar -zxvf yum_mdm.tar.gz', and use 'yum -y localinstall --skip-broken yum_mdm7.9/*' instead of 'yum -y localinstall --skip-broken yum_mdm/*'.
What steps are required to change the time zone of the Smart MDM service after modifying the system time zone?

Run 'sh /mdm_shell/updateTimeZone.sh', enter the time zone according to the prompt, and then restart the Smart MDM service by running 'sh /home/mdm_shell/stop_mdm.sh' followed by 'sh /home/mdm_shell/start_mdmForNewpush.sh'.
How do you configure the number of servers when deploying more than one server?
Find the configuration file /nrm/service/mdm-baseservice/config.properties in the installation directory and modify the value of serverCount to the actual server number.
What are the steps to change the server IP address using the IP Configuration Tool?
Go to Hytera\MDM\NrmServer\IPConfigurationTool in the installation directory, double click IP Configuration Tool.exe, and enter the local IP address or map IP address.
What is the consequence if the port configured for Smart MDM service is occupied by another process on a Windows computer?
The Smart MDM service cannot start.
What are the default ports for Smart MDM server in safety mode and standard mode?
The default port is 8443 when the server is running in safety mode, and 8000 when running in standard mode.
Which process corresponds to the MDM service in Smart MDM?
javaw_nrm.exe
What is the description of the glacier2router.exe process?
Process of ICE service
Which regions correspond to US Central Time in the MySQL time zone reference list?
Costa Rica, Chicago, and Mexico City
What is the time zone description for America/Los_Angeles?
US Pacific Time (Los Angeles)
Which TETRA services and trunking functions does the device support?
The device supports all TETRA services, including group call, broadcast call, DGNA, packet data, authentication, over-the-air encryption, and end-to-end encryption.
What services does Hytera HyTalk MC provide over public networks?
Hytera HyTalk MC provides stable and reliable PTT communication, high-speed data applications and multimedia services.
将 Smart MDM 从 V1.0.16.000 升级到 V4.6.16.000 需要如何操作？
请联系海能达客服。
Smart MDM 是否支持直接升级执法记录仪的蓝牙？如果不支持该怎么办？
当前不支持。如需升级蓝牙，请联系海能达客服。
What are the steps to install the antenna on the PTC760 radio?
1. (Optional) Place the color ring on the antenna connector for identification. 2. Put the antenna on the antenna connector. 3. Rotate the antenna clockwise until it is hand tight.
How should the micro-SIM card be placed on the tray during installation?
Place the micro-SIM card with the gold contacts facing up on the tray.
PPS (Private Positioning Service) 的主要作用是什么？
PPS 可以在终端无 GPS 信号或 GPS 信号弱的情况下提供安全、精确的位置信息服务。
通过 PPS WEB 客户端可以控制哪些内容？
可以通过 PPS WEB 客户端控制接入 PPS 服务器的终端最大数量，以及控制终端接入 PPS 服务器的权限。
PPS 有哪些应用场景？
PPS 的应用场景包括可视化调度和室内通话定位等。
PPS服务器如何获取终端的位置信息？
基站、蓝牙设备等网元提供MAC地址，由终端上传给PPS服务器，PPS服务器将MAC地址换算为位置信息。
哪些终端型号支持接入PPS服务器，且对版本有什么要求？
支持的终端型号包括PDC760、PDC680、PTC760、PTC680，要求终端版本为V3.5及以上版本。
通过网页可以对PPS服务器执行哪些控制操作？
可以通过网页控制接入PPS服务器的终端数量，以及授权或取消终端接入PPS服务器的权限。
部署服务器端时，对操作系统、CPU核心数、内存和磁盘空间的具体要求是什么？
服务器端操作系统需为 CentOS-7-x86_64-Minimal-1611.iso；CPU需16核或以上；内存需32GB或以上；磁盘空间需500GB或以上。
pps.tar.gz 软件包包含哪些组件，其对应的文档中心路径是什么？
pps.tar.gz 包含 tomcat、JDK、MySQL、docker 等组件，文档中心路径为 /Product-Resource/20。
PPS 服务端口号和终端连接 PPS 服务器的端口号分别是多少？
PPS 服务端口号固定为 8080；终端连接 PPS 服务器的端口号固定为 2020。
如何通过 SSH 将 pps.tar.gz、shell_pps、PPS.zip 和 hytera_offline_xx_yyyy.zip 上传至服务器？
使用 SSH 工具通过 root 用户将这些文件上传至服务器所在主机的 /home 目录下。
如何通过拖拽方式将 pps.tar.gz、shell_pps、PPS.zip 和 hytera_offline_xx_yyyy.zip 上传至服务器？
通过拖拽的方式将这些文件上传至服务器所在主机的 /home 目录下。
登录 PPS Linux 服务器时应使用哪个用户？
应使用 root 用户登录。
在 CentOS 图形桌面中如何打开命令行窗口？
单击鼠标右键选择“Open in Terminal”，即可弹出命令行窗口。
需要解压的文件名是什么？
需要解压的文件是 pps.tar.gz。
Which directory does the command change to in the provided text?
/home/pps/apache-tomcat-9.0.33/bin/
如何解压名为 hytera_offline_xx_yyyy.zip 的离线包？
执行命令 unzip hytera_offline_xx_yyyy.zip。
编辑 tracking.yml 配置文件的具体路径是什么？
配置文件的路径为 /home/hytera_offline/server-1/conf/tracking.yml。
服务器IP地址应如何确定？
服务器IP为2.1.3网络规划中的IP地址。
同时安装软件加密狗和硬件加密狗会有什么后果？
会导致加密狗失效。
如何使用 Xftp 工具处理 /home/nrm/dongle 目录下的 local.c2v 文件？
使用 Xftp 工具将 “/home/nrm/dongle” 下的 local.c2v 文件拷贝到 Windows 电脑。
如何将 abc.v2c 文件部署到服务器？
使用 Xftp 工具将 abc.v2c 文件上传到 “/home/nrm/dongle” 目录。
在 PPS Web 客户端中如何导入许可证？
单击右上角 “admin -> 许可证”，单击 “导入许可证”，导入 PPS_License_xxx.zip。
如何替换 /home/hytera_offline/server-1/asset 目录下的 wise resp 定位数据包？
首先删除该目录下的原有 wise resp 数据包，然后通过拖拽的方式将新的 wise resp 上传至同一目录。
在更新 wise resp 文件时，新文件应上传到哪个具体路径？
/home/hytera_offline/server-1/asset
MDM Pro 设计容灾机制的主要目的是什么？
确保在主服务器出现故障时，备用服务能够迅速恢复并保持长期稳定运行。
MDM Pro 容灾部署包含哪两种模式？
MDM Pro 容灾部署分为单 IP 本地部署与双 IP 异地部署。
MDM Pro 双 IP 异地部署如何实现主服务器故障后的业务连续性？
在双 IP 异地部署中，主备服务器部署在不同的两处区域。当主服务器遭受火灾地震等自然灾害时，只要备服务器所在地区正常，备服务器可快速接替主服务器继续工作。
备服务器的数量和服务类型应如何与主服务器对应？
备服务器的数量与对应服务均需要与主服务器保持一致。
若主服务器分布式部署包含一台 base 服务器、一台 mysql 服务器和一台 request 服务器，备服务器应如何准备？
备份服务器也需要准备三台：一台 base 服务器、一台 mysql 服务器、一台 request 服务器。
配置备服务器时应参考《Hytera MDM Pro 安装配置指南》中的哪些章节？
应参考“2 自备服务器”章节与“7 分布式部署”章节。
如何在主备 base 服务器上配置虚拟 IP 模式？
在主备 base 服务器编辑 “/home/nrm/service/TerminalHandler” 目录下的 “config.properties”文件，在指定位置输入数字 0。
如何启动 keepalived 服务？
执行命令：systemctl start keepalived
如何停止 keepalived 服务？
执行命令：systemctl stop keepalived
执行 masterslavepconfig.sh 脚本的完整命令路径是什么？
执行该脚本的完整命令是 sh /home/mdm_shell/master-slave-shell/masterslavepconfig.sh。
如何配置备 base 服务器的账号、密码和 SSH 端口？
编辑“/home/nrm/service/disasterRecovery”目录下的“address.properties”文件，在指定位置输入备 base 服务器的账号、密码和 SSH 端口。
Which port is used for SSH in the target login configuration?
What is the target IP address for the master server?
如何配置主 base 服务器的账号、密码和 SSH 端口？
编辑“/home/nrm/service/disasterRecovery”目录下的“address.properties”文件，在指定位置输入主 base 服务器的账号、密码和 SSH 端口。
What are the configured IP and port for the standby server?
The standby server IP is 127.0.0.1 (representing the primary server IP) and the port is 8083.
在主 mysql 服务器执行命令时，需要根据提示输入哪些信息？
本机 IP、备服务器 base 服务器 IP、备服务器 mysql 服务器 IP 以及本机的主备属性。
在配置主从服务器时，target_ip 和 target_sql_ip 分别代表什么？
target_ip 代表备服务器base服务器IP，target_sql_ip 代表备服务器mysql服务器IP。
在配置灾难恢复服务时，需要编辑哪个具体路径下的哪个配置文件？
需要编辑 "/home/nrm/service/disasterRecovery" 目录下的 "address.properties" 文件。
What role is set for the system, master or slave?
slave
What is the command to execute the requestIpconfig.sh script?
sh /home/mdm_shell/master-slave-shell/requestIpconfig.sh
What is the full path of the script executed in the command?
/home/mdm shell/master-slave-shell/requestIpconfig.sh
What local IP address was input during the script execution?
What is the full package name of rsync on the el9 system?
What is the full package name of rsync on the el7_9 system?
What is the output of running 'rpm -qa | grep inotify-tools' on this system?
inotify-tools-3.14-9.el7.x86_64
在主备 base 服务器上如何退出密钥生成命令？
在主备 base 服务器上连续按【Enter】键直至退出该命令。
在主服务器执行命令时，远程服务器 IP 应设置为什么？
备服务器 IP。
在备服务器执行命令时，远程服务器 IP 应设置为什么？
主服务器 IP。
数据库同步配置需要在哪些服务器上执行？
仅需在主备 mysql 服务器上执行。
在主 mysql 服务器上添加配置时，需要修改哪个文件的哪个节点？
需要修改 “/etc” 目录下 “/my.cnf” 文件的 “mysqId” 节点。
Which database is excluded from binary logging according to the binlog-ignore-db setting?
mysql
What SQL command updates the host for the root user to allow connections from any host?
UPDATE user SET host='%' WHERE user='root';
What command grants all privileges on all databases to the root user connecting from any host?
GRANT ALL ON .* TO 'root@%';
Which command should be executed to reload privilege tables after making changes?
FLUSH PRIVILEGES;
What is the Master_Host value associated with the state 'Replica has read all relay log; waiting for more updates' in the synchron_sql.sh output?
在备 base 服务器上创建 systemLicen se 文件夹时，应进入哪个目录？
/home/nrm/service/mdm-baseservice/data/
如何处理备 base 服务器的系统许可证文件？
将备 base 服务器的系统许可证解压，并将解压后的文件上传至 “systemLicense” 文件夹中。
在修改备 base 服务器上的 license 文件名时，应遵循什么命名规则？
需将备 base 服务器上 zip 类型 license 文件名改成和主 base 服务器相同路径下的 license 文件名一致。
配置好主备服务器后，终端首先连接哪台服务器？
主服务器
在什么情况下终端会自动切换到备服务器连接？
主服务器无法访问、备服务区可以访问时，终端会自动切换到备服务器连接。
什么是服务通路？
服务通路是指专用网关与用户的服务器之间的通信。
MDM Pro 采用单 IP 本地部署时，面临火灾或地震等自然灾害会有什么风险？
当服务器遭受火灾地震等自然灾害时，主备服务器将不可用。
容灾部署前，备服务器的数量要求是多少？
备服务器只需准备一台。
容灾部署前，备服务器需要安装哪些软件环境？
需要在备服务器上安装与主服务器一致的操作系统和 MDM 服务。
在哪里可以查阅备服务器准备的详细参考指南？
可参考《Hytera MDM Pro 安装配置指南》中的“2 自备服务器”章节。
在主服务器执行容灾部署命令时，需要根据提示输入哪些信息？
需要根据提示输入本机 IP、备服务器 IP 以及本机 IP 的主备属性。
如何编辑 TerminalHandler 目录下的 config.properties 文件？
编辑“/home/nrm/service/TerminalHandler”目录下的“config.properties”文件，在指定位置输入数字 1 和本机 IP。
在配置灾难恢复服务时，如何设置 address.properties 文件中的主服务器连接信息？
需编辑“/home/nrm/service/disasterRecovery”目录下的“address.properties”文件，并在指定位置输入主服务器账号、密码和 SSH 端口。
What is the full package name of rsync for EL9 shown in the output?
What is the full package name of rsync for EL7 shown in the output?
在主服务器执行时，远程服务器 IP 应设置为什么？
备服务器 IP
在备服务器执行时，远程服务器 IP 应设置为什么？
主服务器 IP
Which database is excluded from binary logging in this configuration?
The mysql database is excluded from binary logging.
What is the name of the binary log file specified in the configuration?
mdm-mysql-bin
如何将备服务器的系统许可证文件部署到指定目录？
将备服务器的系统许可证解压，并将解压后的文件上传至“systemlicense”文件夹中。
在备服务器上处理zip类型license文件名时有什么要求？
需将备服务器上zip类型license文件名改成和主服务器相同路径下的license文件名一致。
在主服务器无法访问但备服务器可以访问的情况下，终端会如何操作？
自动切换到备服务器连接
MDM 对应的英文全称和中文全称是什么？
MDM 的英文全称是 Mobile Device Management，中文全称是移动设备管理系统。
What action is required during the first login to KMS regarding the database?
You need to set the database password that is used to migrate KMS data.
What are the steps to export a key pack for Smart MDM?
To export a key pack for Smart MDM, select MDM to access the Export window, click Browse, and then select the key application form.
上报地址和端口的作用是什么，如何获取？
上报地址/端口是Smart MDM服务器IP地址及端口号，用于用户端上报数据。需联系Smart MDM服务器管理员获取。
MDM代表什么系统？
Mobile Device Management (移动设备管理系统)
What are the supported video file types listed in the specifications?

The supported video file types are 3GPP (.3gp), MPEG-4 (.mp4), QuickTime (.mov), WEBM (.webm), Windows Media (.asf, .wmv), RealMedia (.rmvb, .rm), MPEG-PS (.mpg, .mpeg), MPEG-TS (.ts), AVI (.avi), and Matroska (.mkv).
What is the correct procedure for installing the antenna on the PDM680?
First, optionally put the color ring on the antenna connector. Second, put the antenna on the antenna connector. Finally, rotate the antenna clockwise until it is hand tight.
What prerequisite action must be taken before re-installing a Micro SD card?
You must completely take out the Micro SD card before re-installing it.
海能达的服务热线是多少？
该设备的充电接口类型及电池安装相关部件是什么？
充电接口为USB Type-C接口，电池安装相关部件包括电池推钮、电池和充电极片。
如何正确安装电池到主机槽内？
将电池底部左右两侧的导向扣位对准放入主机槽内，轻压电池并往电池槽方向推动，直至听到“咔嗒”声音。
在电池电量低于两格时，能否进行系统升级？升级过程中有什么禁止操作？
电池电量低于两格时，无法升级系统。升级过程中禁止拆卸电池。
MDM Pro系统能够从设备采集哪些数据以消除威胁隐患？
可从设备采集写频参数以及诊断日志等各种数据，从而全面掌控设备并及时消除威胁隐患。
在MDM Pro服务器上安装加密狗驱动前，需要使用哪个用户登录？
需要使用root用户登录MDM Pro服务器。
如何获取并处理MDM服务器的加密狗授权文件？
获取我司提供的加密狗授权文件local.v2c和License，并将加密狗授权文件local.v2c导入到MDM服务器。
监管场所中哪些重要部位必须安装通信设备？
技术总控制室、民警值班室、所领导办公室、收押室、岗楼、讯问指挥室、内勤室、武警值班室和囚车等重要部位必须安装通信设备。
Can a supplementary service be offered to a customer as a stand-alone service?
No, a supplementary service cannot be offered to a customer as a stand-alone service. It must be offered in combination with a bearer service or a teleservice.
How should elements and services within a managed network be modelled to assist operators?
They need to be modelled in an abstract manner, so as to allow the operator to exercise actions and controls without needing in-depth knowledge of each of the pieces of equipment being managed.
What are the objectives for establishing a flexible management environment given the growth of services?
A flexible management environment is established to enable rapid service deployment, promote faster service activation, and efficiently manage and distribute data throughout the network.
According to ITU-T Recommendation M.3400, what is the description of the Performance Management Functional Area?
The Performance Management Functional Area provides functions to evaluate and report on the behaviour of equipment.
What are typical examples of services available locally in TETRA network management?

Typical local services include subscriber basic data management, basic service data management, supplementary service management, closed user group management, and configuration management (which involves maintaining the integrity of system hardware and software).
在未安装 SIM 卡的情况下，满足什么条件可以拨打紧急呼救电话？
在紧急情况下，如果设备信号在运营商网络覆盖范围内，即使没有安装 SIM 卡，也可以拨打紧急呼救电话。
选择首选网络类型的操作路径是什么？使用前对4G网络有何要求？
操作路径为点击“高级 > 首选网络类型”，可选择2G、3G或4G网络。在使用4G网络前，需确认SIM卡为4G卡并已开通4G业务。
What is the command to copy the local public key to a remote server, and how should the Remote Server IP be determined based on the current server role?

The command is `ssh-copy-id -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub root@Remote Server IP`. When running this on the active server, the Remote Server IP should be the IP address of the standby server. When running it on the standby server, the Remote Server IP should be the IP address of the active server.
What MySQL configuration settings must be added to the 'mysql' section of the my.cnf file on the active server?

On the active server, add the following to the 'mysql' section: `server_id=1`, `binlog-ignore-db=mysql`, `log-bin=mdm-mysql-bin`, `binlog_cache_size=1M`, `binlog_format=mixed`, `expire_logs_days=7`, `slave_skip_errors=1062`, `relay_log=mdm-mysql-relay-bin`, `log_slave_updates=1`, `auto_increment_increment=2`, and `auto_increment_offset=1`.
What steps must be performed on the standby server regarding the system license file?

On the standby server: 1. Go to the "/home/nrm/service/mdm-baseservice/data/" directory and create a "systemLicense" folder. 2. Decompress the system license and upload the files to the "systemLicense" folder. 3. Rename the license file (.zip file) to match the filename on the active server.
What prerequisite must be met before starting the disaster recovery service, and what command is used to start it?

Before starting the disaster recovery service, ensure MDM Pro has loaded organization data on both active and standby servers. The command to start the service is: sh /home/mdm_shell/master-slave-shell/reset_monitor.sh
Smart MDM在远程写频和升级方面有哪些主要优势？
Smart MDM支持远程对终端进行写频和升级，无需统一回收终端。无论终端位于崇山峻岭、钻井平台、附近街区还是遥远的海外，均可在办公室内操作，从而保障业务的持续性。
限制用户卸载重要应用或指定重要应用持续运行的目的是什么？
目的是避免终端用户错过工作信息，并且确保终端安全、统一、规范地运行应用。
Smart MDM 对接 UUC（统一用户中心）的主要作用是什么？

What is the full name and Chinese translation of MDM?
Mobile Device Management (移动设备管理系统)
How is priority level determined for groups when the Priority Group feature is enabled, and how does it affect service requests?

A larger number represents a higher priority (levels 1, 2, or 3). When receiving service requests from several groups in a voice call, the radio preferentially participates in the service of the group with a higher priority.
Which services remain available when airplane mode is enabled?
In airplane mode, you can use services over WLAN network or BT, initiate narrowband services, and use apps that require no cellular data connection.
How does the 'Siren Only' emergency alarm service differ from the 'Regular' service regarding signal transmission?

The 'Siren Only' service emits a siren but does not transmit any emergency signal to the control center, whereas the 'Regular' service transmits the emergency signal to the control center with visible and audible indications.
Which emergency alarm service types allow the dealer to set specific emergency modes such as Call Only, Alarm w/Call, or Alarm?
The emergency alarm service types that allow setting these emergency modes are Regular, Silent, and Silent w/Voice.
How can normal use be restored if a radio is killed by the dispatch station or trunking system?
To restore normal use, send the radio back to the Company.
Under what conditions will the radio system fail to upgrade?
The radio system cannot be upgraded when the battery level is below 30% or the storage space is insufficient. Additionally, unauthorized software must not be used for upgrades.
What network conditions must be met for a radio to log in to the Smart MDM server after registration?
The radio must have the network connected. If the status is disconnected, you need to enable mobile data or connect to the WLAN network.
What happens to the data and the device state during and after a factory reset via Smart MDM?

During the process, the radio displays "Factory reset," and all data including system and SD card data, or encryption key is deleted. After the factory reset is complete, the radio will restart automatically.
What should be done if the radio cannot be turned on due to improper battery installation?
Remove and reattach the battery.
What should you do if the radio fails to detect the Nano SIM card or Micro SD card due to improper installation?
Remove and reinstall the Nano SIM card or Micro SD card.
What is the full name of the abbreviation MDM?
Mobile Device Management
How do you stop the Smart MDM service during the upgrade process?
Go to "C:\Hytera\MDM\NrmServer", right-click StopAllService.bat, and choose Run as administrator.

The default installation directory is "C:\Hytera\MDM\NrmServer".
What is the first step to initiate the MDMServer installation?

What is the procedure to upgrade the Admin Client using the MDMAdminClient_Upgrade_V1.6.07.000.zip file?

What action is required regarding the programming plugin after the Admin Client has been successfully upgraded?
The programming plugin needs to be uploaded and updated after the Admin Client has been successfully upgraded.
How does the User Client upgrade process differ depending on whether the server includes the upgrade plugin?

If the server includes the plugin uploaded by other administrators, the User Client automatically prompts for an upgrade. If the server does not include the plugin, you need to upload the plugin first, and then the User Client will automatically prompt for an upgrade.
Which files must be uploaded to upgrade the Smart MDM User Client and the DMR narrowband plugin?
To upgrade the Smart MDM User Client, upload MDMUserClient_Upgrade_V1.6.07.000.zip. For the DMR narrowband plugin, upload G1_DMR_UserClient_V1.6.03.000.01plug.
KMC 和 MDM 分别指代什么系统或中心？
KMC 指密钥管理中心（Key Management Center），MDM 指移动设备管理系统（Mobile Device Management）。
Which video formats are supported by the device?

Smart MDM专业版支持对哪些类型的终端进行批量化写频和升级？
Smart MDM专业版可提供对多模终端的批量化写频、升级，也可提供对窄带终端和执法记录仪的批量化写频、升级。
Smart MDM采用什么架构，管理员如何登录进行管理？

集成设备工作站通过什么方式与 Smart MDM 连接？
通过 Internet 连接。

从R3.0以前的版本升级到R3.0版本时，公网联系人、短信和呼叫记录的数据分别存储在哪里并如何显示？
升级后，公网联系人的数据存到Android联系人的数据库，并根据新的Android联系人界面进行显示；公网短信的数据存到Android短信的数据库，并根据新的Android短信界面进行显示；公网呼叫记录的数据存到Android呼叫记录的数据库，并根据新的Android呼叫记录界面进行显示。
从R3.0以前的版本升级到R3.0版本时，专网联系人、短信和呼叫记录的数据分别存储在哪里并如何显示？
升级后，专网联系人数据存到专网应用的联系人数据库，并根据新的专网应用联系人界面进行显示；专网短信数据存到专网应用的会话数据库，并根据新的专网应用会话界面进行显示；专网呼叫记录数据存到专网应用的会话数据库，并根据新的专网应用会话界面进行显示。
升级后，还原R3.0之前版本备份的短信数据时，公网短信和专网短信分别如何处理？
还原时，公网短信的数据存到Android短信的数据库，并根据新的Android短信界面进行显示；专网短信的数据存到专网应用的会话数据库，并根据新的专网应用会话界面进行显示。
录音文件路径中目录名前缀“TG”代表什么含义？
TG代表Trunking Group Call，即集群组呼。
为什么组管理页面不支持通过号码搜索？
因为组管理搜索不是在数据库中搜索，没有联系人号码，只显示了联系人别名。
What is the primary function of the Server component in Smart MDM Professional, and how does Safe mode enhance security?
The Server stores and processes all Smart MDM Professional data, such as asset information and device records. Safe mode enhances data security by using an advanced transmission protocol.

How should the antenna be installed?
First, optionally put the color ring on the antenna connector. Then, put the antenna on the antenna connector. Finally, rotate the antenna clockwise till hand tight.
How do you install Nano SIM cards and optionally Micro SD cards?

1. Open the card slot cover. 2. Install the Nano SIM cards into the corresponding slots. 3. (Optional) Insert the Micro SD cards into the corresponding slots with the metal contacts facing down. 4. Put the card slot cover back in place.
What services are unavailable and which remain accessible when airplane mode is enabled?

In airplane mode, voice and data services cannot be used. However, services over WLAN network or BT can be used, narrowband services can be initiated, and apps that require no cellular data connection can be used.
How is an emergency service initiated and ended using the preprogrammed keys?
To initiate an emergency service, press the preprogrammed Emergency on key (short press TK by default). To end the service, press the preprogrammed Emergency off key (long press TK by default).
How can a user restore normal use if the radio is permanently disabled?
To restore normal use after permanent disablement, send the radio back to the Company.
How can you manage apps in the app center, such as repositioning, uninstalling, or creating folders?

To reposition an app, touch and hold the app icon and drag it to a new location. To uninstall a non-system app, touch and hold the app icon and tap Uninstall App. To create an app folder, touch and hold the app icon and drag it to another app.
What are the available options for setting the tone for call services?
The available options for call service tones are Broadband, Narrowband, and Vibrations.
Under what conditions does the radio emit an alert tone for message services?
With Message tone turned on, the radio emits an alert tone when receiving a message or failing to send the message.
What happens to the radio in TMO when Auto-switch network is turned on and it goes out of service?
The radio automatically switches to another network.
What functions remain available on the radio when Graceful Service Degradation Mode (GSDM) is enabled and the signal is weak or no LA is available?
The radio can still receive group calls, initiate or receive emergency calls, and send or receive emergency status messages.
Under what conditions can the radio system not be upgraded?
The radio system cannot be upgraded when the battery level is below 30% or the storage space is insufficient.
What happens to ongoing services during a radio system upgrade?
During the upgrade, the radio terminates the ongoing services.
What are the prohibited physical handling and environmental conditions for the radio to ensure its service life?

Do not disassemble, throw, crack, hammer, pierce, or scrape the radio, especially the interfaces. Do not hold the radio by its antenna. Avoid exposing it to extreme temperatures (lower than -20°C or higher than 55°C) and keep it away from corrosive substances. Additionally, close the accessory connector cover when no accessory is in use and do not connect the radio to other incompatible radios.
How should the battery be charged to guarantee optimum performance and long service life?

自动停止，提示“文件保存成功”，以当前时间命名保存一个Trace日志文件，然后重新开始保存一个trace。
宽带离线日志文件的存储路径和命名格式是什么？
宽带日志文件保存在/sdcard/logs/目录下，文件命名格式为Aplog_当前年_月日_时分秒。
窄带Log文件的存储路径及文件名结构是怎样的？
窄带日志文件保存在 /sdcard/nblogs/ 目录下，文件名结构为“语音问题__当前年_月日_时分秒”，其中“语音问题”代表日志类型。
宽带离线日志和窄带Log是否保存在同一个文件夹中？

在锁屏状态（亮屏/灭屏）下，使用“SK2+Home”组合键开始抓取日志的流程是怎样的？

按下“SK2+Home”组合键。

终端被遥晕、远程锁定或进入外呼业务时，是否会影响正在进行的日志抓取操作？
不会影响正在进行的日志抓取操作。
工程模式下对日志的配置会在哪里同步显示？
在Quick Log中同步显示。

You must follow the procedure described in the document to back up server data.

The Smart MDM service must be stopped by running the corresponding command.

config.properties

First run 1.5.11_1.6.07.sql, and then run 1.6.07_2.0.16.sql.

What are the steps to modify the IP in the config.client configuration file?

It might take up to 5 minutes after the next failed transfer for FileZilla Server to recognize the changed IP. In most cases, the IP is updated within 30 seconds after a failed transfer.
What is the difference between upgrading the Admin Client with and without an upgrade plugin?

With an upgrade plugin, the server includes the plugin uploaded by other administrators, and the Admin Client automatically prompts for an upgrade. Without a plugin, the server does not include it; you must upload the plugin first and then execute the upgrade.
Which files must be uploaded for IDS upgrade when the server does not include the plugin?

The following files must be uploaded: MDMUserClient_Upgrade_V2.0.16.000.zip for the IDS upgrade package, G1_DMR_UserClient_V2.0.08.000.07plug for DMR narrowband radio, G1_Tetra_UsersClient_V2.0.08.000.01.plug for TETRA narrowband radio, G2_UsersClient_V2.0.08.000.05.plug for multi-mode radio, and RVM_UsersClient_V2.0.08.002.03.plug for RVM.
How does the IDS upgrade prompt behavior differ based on whether the server includes a plugin?

With an upgrade plugin, the server includes the plugin uploaded by other administrators, and IDS automatically prompts upgrade. Without a plugin, the server doesn't include the plugin; you need to upload the plugin first, and then IDS automatically prompts upgrade.
How do you configure the keystoreFile and keystorePass values in server.xml on a Linux server?
Change the value of keystoreFile to /home/nrm/sk/HyteraMDMkey and change the value of keystorePass to 666666. If using a custom private key, enter the corresponding key password instead of 666666.
How do you start the Smart MDM service on a Windows server after configuration?
Go to the directory Installation Directory\Hytera\MDM\NrmServer, right-click StartAllService.bat, and choose Run as administrator.

Choose Place all certificates in the following store, then click Browse to access the window Select Certificate Store. 4. Choose Trusted Root Certificate Authorities and click OK. 5. What is the solution if the Admin Client or IDS fails to connect to the server after a server upgrade?
Uninstall Admin Client or IDS, then reinstall it and choose safe mode to connect to the server.
Under what conditions might the Admin Client or IDS fail to connect to the server after an upgrade?

The Admin Client or IDS can connect to the server before server upgrade, but fails to connect after server upgrade. This may occur when the server mode is set to safe mode, but the Admin Client or IDS cannot configure safe mode before upgrade.
What are the required Host, Protocol, Username, and Password settings when configuring a new SFTP session to transfer files to a Linux server?
The Host should be the IP of the Linux server, the Protocol should be SFTP, the Username should be root, and the Password should be the password of root.
How do you uninstall the driver for a device connected to IDS?
Go to Control Panel -> Program -> Uninstall a program to uninstall the driver.
What is the process for automatic plugin upgrades in the IDS system?
After the administrator uploads a plugin to the Admin Station, the User Client automatically downloads the plugin and executes upgrade.
What are the port numbers for safe mode and common mode when setting the Server Address?
The port of safe mode is 8085, and the port of common mode is 8083.
如何在终端上进入 Quick Log 界面以一键上传日志文件到 Smart MDM？
在终端拨号盘输入“*#*#0311#*#*”即可进入 Quick Log。
在 Smart MDM 中开启自升级模式后，终端的管控状态和升级行为是怎样的？
设置自升级模式之后，Smart MDM 无法管控终端。终端会定期查询 Smart MDM 上是否有升级固件，如果查询到新版本则提醒用户升级。
Smart MDM 的自升级模式与强管控模式是否可以同时开启？如果可以，终端处于什么状态？
可以同时开启。此时终端既可以自升级，也接受 Smart MDM 管控。
在 Smart MDM 中设置强管控模式后，具备哪些功能？
设置强管控模式之后，Smart MDM 可以正常管控终端，并且可以更换终端内的 Smart MDM 服务器地址。
工作站处理执法记录仪任务的优先级顺序是什么？
写频 > 读频 > 数据采集 > 升级。
Smart MDM 是否支持升级执法记录仪的蓝牙？如果不支持应如何处理？
当前不支持升级执法记录仪的蓝牙，如需升级蓝牙，请联系海能达客服。
宽窄带融合对讲机的通信路径相比传统对讲机有何变化？
对讲机从过去依赖于单一路径变成了多路径通信。
外部数据服务如何以Web Service形式在信息整合平台中使用？
可在信息整合平台被映射为虚拟的表。
智能移动设备管理系统在安全管理方面包含哪些具体管控措施？
安全管理包括应用软件安装管控、软件访问权限管控、远程设备开启或禁用，以及远程数据备份和擦除。
在应用管理方面，系统采取了哪些措施来防止违规应用安装并实现统一管理？
系统通过统一管理的APPStore显著减少应用违规情况，支持应用远程推送到设备上统一管理，并利用黑白名单有效防止非法应用的安装。此外，还支持远程为对讲机安装或卸载应用。
管理端和用户端在磁盘空间需求上有何区别？
安装程序所需空间均为 2GB 或以上。但在运行产生存储数据方面，建议管理端准备 40GB 磁盘空间，而建议用户端准备 320GB 磁盘空间。
服务器端运行产生的数据存储建议预留多少磁盘空间？
建议为服务器端运行产生的数据存储准备 1TB 磁盘空间。
Nano SIM卡和Micro SD卡的安装方向及注意事项是什么？
插入Nano SIM卡时需注意缺口方向；插入Micro SD卡时需将金属触点面朝下。拆装Micro SD卡时，请确保完全拔出后再插入。
添加VPN配置文件前需要满足什么前提条件？
在添加 VPN 配置文件前，请先开启数字或图形锁屏。
如何添加新的VPN配置文件？
在配置界面，点击 + ，添加并保存 VPN 配置文件。
使用非官方软件升级系统可能带来哪些风险？
可能会导致设备发生故障或丢失数据，破坏系统安全能力，并触发安全风险。
在什么条件下无法进行系统升级？
电池电量低于 30% 或空间不足时，无法升级系统。
升级过程中对讲机的状态如何变化，以及升级完成后的表现是什么？
升级过程中，对讲机不响应并终止正在进行的业务。整机升级完成后，对讲机会自动重启，开机提示系统升级成功。
What does the 'Danger' icon indicate in the Smart MDM Professional documentation?
The 'Danger' icon indicates situations that could cause major personal injury or even death.
How does the firmware upgrade capability for narrowband radios change in this version compared to previous single radio upgrades?
This version supports simultaneous firmware upgrade of 6 DMR radios and 24 TETRA radios, instead of upgrading a single radio at a time.
What is the correct procedure to install a SIM card into the radio?

1. Use a Phillips screwdriver to loosen the screw on the SIM card cover. 2. Use a flathead screwdriver to remove the SIM card cover. 3. Use a flathead screwdriver to extract the SIM card tray. 4. Place the SIM card into the tray with the notch on the SIM card aligned with the notch. 5. Insert the SIM card tray into the radio.
What is the purpose of the acknowledged data transfer service?
This service is used by the layer 3 entities to get a secure transmission including retransmissions.
How is a basic link defined in terms of connection type and services?
A basic link is a bidirectional connectionless path between one or several MSs and a BS, providing both unacknowledged and acknowledged services on a single message basis.
What is the function of a Service Access Point (SAP)?
A Service Access Point (SAP) is an interface point through which the services of one layer are provided to the immediately higher layer.
What are Service Data Units (SDUs) and Protocol Data Units (PDUs), and how do they relate during data transmission?

SDUs are blocks of data passed through the service boundary for transmission by a layer. PDUs are used to transfer data between peer entities. A PDU may contain an SDU passed down from the layer above plus any necessary PDU header added at the current layer.
What are Service Access Points (SAPs) and where are they located?
Service Access Points (SAPs) are interface points where the services of one layer are provided to the immediately higher layer. There may be multiple SAPs at one layer boundary.
What is the purpose of service primitives in the protocol model?
Service primitives are used at each layer interface to provide the interaction between the service user at one layer and the service provider at the layer below.
Which entity is responsible for call control, supplementary services, and short data?
The Circuit Mode Control Entity (CMCE) deals with call control, supplementary services and short data.
What services does the Subnetwork Dependent Convergence Protocol layer (SNDCP) provide?
The Subnetwork Dependent Convergence Protocol layer (SNDCP) provides the packet data services.
Are TETRA Service Access Points (SAPs) and primitives considered testable?
No, TETRA SAPs and primitives are not testable.
What are Service Access Points (SAPs) in the context of layer services?
Service Access Points (SAPs) are interface points where the services of one layer are provided to the immediately higher layer.
Which TETRA protocol model layer provides packet data services through SAPs to APIs and applications?
The Multimedia Exchange (MEX) layer, located at the top of the TETRA protocol model, provides packet data services including high speed data services through SAPs to APIs and applications.
To which external networks can the TETRA HSD service connect?
The TETRA HSD service can connect to another TETRA network, an external GPRS/3G network, and a third unspecified external IP packet data network.
Which Quality of Service (QoS) attributes can be negotiated between the protocol and the application in the enhanced TETRA protocols?
The QoS attributes included in negotiations are data class, throughput, delay, and reliability.
How does the IP packet data bearer service support concurrent multimedia applications in TETRA HSD?
The service access points provided by the IP packet data bearer service allow handling concurrent multimedia applications through a Multimedia Exchange (MEX) layer.
Describe the mechanism by which the MEX precedence switch services buffers.
The precedence switch services high-precedence buffers more frequently than lower-precedence buffers.
Which Internet Protocol versions does the TETRA packet data service support, and what addressing modes are available?
The TETRA packet data service supports Internet Protocol (IP) versions 4 and 6. It includes IPv4 static and dynamic addressing, as well as mobile IPv4 and IPv6 addressing.
How does the MS SNDCP initiate the setup of a new acknowledged advanced link?
The MS SNDCP asks layer 2 to set up the link and passes layer 2 QoS parameters that suit the QoS requirements of the PDP contexts assigned to use that link.
Which SAPs are used for internal communication between the LLC and MAC, and what services do they correspond to?

Internal communication between the LLC and MAC uses TMA-SAP, TMB-SAP, and TMC-SAP for services provided by the MAC to the LLC, corresponding to the separation between signalling, broadcast, and layer management. An additional SAP, TLE-SAP, may also be used for the layer 2 signalling service that the LLC may provide to the MAC.
What are the two types of communication links provided by the LLC as a service to the MLE?
The two types of communication links provided by the LLC are the basic link and the advanced link.
Which entity handles retransmissions when the LLC provides an acknowledged service to higher layers?
The LLC is responsible for sending retransmissions if it does not receive an acknowledgement.
Does the unacknowledged basic link service guarantee in-order delivery if a PDU is sent multiple times?
No, the unacknowledged basic link service does not guarantee in-order delivery at the receiving LLC if the PDU is sent more than once.
What are the characteristics of the layer 2 signalling service regarding message transmission and delivery order?
The layer 2 signalling service provides unacknowledged message transmission with un-numbered fragmentation of longer messages. It does not guarantee in-order delivery at the receiving entity.
Through which specific SAP does the LLC provide the layer 2 signalling service to the MAC when the PDU relates to a MAC function?
The LLC provides the layer 2 signalling service to the MAC through a specific SAP called the TLE-SAP.
How does the MAC initiate the transmission of a layer 2 signalling message using the LLC service?
The MAC issues a request primitive at the TLE-SAP containing the information to be sent in the layer 2 signalling PDU.
In a three-reliability-level system for advanced link segments, when is reliability level 3 used?

Reliability level 3 is used for a segment when it has been sent a specific number of times without success, and/or when only a specific number of retransmissions remain before the maximum number of segment retransmissions of that segment is exceeded.
What are the two methods by which the SNDCP service user can define the data priority of data packets?

The SNDCP service user can define data priority by: 1. Providing a data priority for each PDP context as a default data priority for data packets using that PDP context. 2. Allowing the SNDCP service user to set a data priority for individual data packets.
How does the SNDCP handle scheduled data received from the service user after the initial transmission?
The SNDCP buffers the scheduled data until it receives a schedule timing prompt, and then sends the appropriate number of scheduled data packets upon receiving that prompt.
How do service comparisons between serving and neighbour cells affect cell reselection thresholds?

One set of thresholds applies if the service provided on the neighbour cell is the same as on the serving cell, leading to reselection when the serving cell is declared 'radio improvable'. Different thresholds apply if the neighbour cell's service is lower than the serving cell's, potentially postponing reselection until the serving cell is declared 'radio relinquishable'.
How does 'background' scanning affect service with the current serving cell?
In background scanning, communications with the current serving cell are maintained in parallel with the scanning, and the scanning causes no interruption to that service.
What is the nominal shape of the service area covered by the main carrier in the provided examples?
The service area covered by the main carrier is nominally circular.
What entity within the CMCE offers the TETRA Short Data Service (SDS)?
The TETRA Short Data Service (SDS) is offered by the SDS entity within the CMCE.
What is the bit length of pre-coded status messages supported by the pre-coded message service?
The pre-coded message service supports 16-bit pre-coded status messages.
Which services are provided by the SDS-TL protocol?

The SDS-TL protocol provides point-to-point, point-to-multipoint and broadcast message transfer; end-to-end acknowledgement of message receipt and consumption by application; store and forward; and support for multiple application protocols.
How does the slot arrangement in Figure 7.23 enable a frequency half duplex MS to support single-slot duplex call services?

The arrangement uses only one downlink slot and the corresponding same-numbered uplink slot in a single TDMA frame. This allows time division duplex operation to be realized, enabling the MS to support single-slot duplex call services.
What services may a fast switching MS fully support if the BS allocates two slots with adjacent numbers?
It may fully support two concurrent single-slot channels or a two-slot duplex call service.
How does link adaptation help maintain service continuity beyond the original channel range without strictly extending the range?

Link adaptation allows continuity of service by employing dynamic modulation level and coding-rate adaptation in response to channel performance, using a lower modulation level or coding rate to avoid a break in communication.
What determines the cell radius in Air-Ground-Air (AGA) service operations?
In AGA service, the cell radius is controlled by round trip delay rather than by RF path loss.
What type of block code is used for header coding in the simulation setup?
Header coding uses a Reed Muller (16,5) block code as the constituent code.
Which version introduced the installation methods for CentOS, and when was it issued?
Version R3.5_V8.0, issued in July 2020, added the installation methods of CentOS.
What are the primary functions of the Server component in Smart MDM?
The Server stores and processes all Smart MDM data, such as asset information and device records.
What responsibilities distinguish a Super administrator from an Administrator in Smart MDM?

A Super administrator manages devices and licenses, sets the system (such as creating groups and administrators and importing devices), while an Administrator manages devices and related resources and pushes resources to devices.
What are the supported operating systems for the Smart MDM server and the Admin Client/IDS?

For the Server, the supported operating systems are Windows Server 2008_64-bit and Windows Server 2012_64-bit. For the Admin Client/IDS, the supported operating systems are Windows 7_32/64-bit and Windows 10_32/64-bit.
Which files are included in the Linux installation package for Smart MDM and what are their descriptions?

The Linux installation package includes: MDMServer.tar.gz (Smart MDM server package, containing JDK, Tomcat and Nginx), sql (Database installation package), and mdm_shell (Script file for installing and starting Smart MDM server).
What are the first two steps to prepare the installation media using UltraISO?
Step 1 is to insert the USB flash drive to a computer installed with the UltraISO. Step 2 is to right-click the UltraISO on the desktop and select Run as administrator.
How do you configure a server to boot from the prepared USB flash drive?

Insert the bootable USB flash drive into the server. Enter the BIOS according to the server brand, set the USB flash drive as the first boot item, save the settings, and let the system automatically reboot. Alternatively, enter the boot device interface, select the USB flash drive as the boot device, save the settings, and the system will restart automatically.
Which installation option should be selected in the welcome interface for CentOS Linux 7?
Select 'Install CentOS Linux 7'. Do not select the option that begins with UEFI.
Why is it necessary to adjust the system time during the CentOS Linux 7 installation, and how can it be done?

An incorrect system time may cause the Smart MDM installation to fail. To adjust it, click DATE & TIME, change the Region (e.g., to 'Asia') and City (e.g., to 'Shanghai'). If NTP is required, networking must be set up first.
What steps are required to handle disk partitioning before beginning the installation?

Click INSTALLATION DESTINATION to select the hard disk. If the hard disk is already partitioned, click Reclaim space and then Delete all. This step is optional if the disk is not partitioned. Finally, click Begin Installation.
What are the steps to install Smart MDM on a Linux server after uploading the necessary files?

Unzip MDMServer.tar.gz using 'tar -zxvf MDMServer.tar.gz'. Install Smart MDM by executing 'sh /home/mdm_shell/mdm_install.sh'. Finally, verify successful installation by checking components with 'ss -tupln|grep -E "8082|8083|8889|5222|8087|8088|9999|8000"'.
Which ports should be checked to verify that Smart MDM components are installed successfully?
How do you restart the network service on the server?
Execute the command 'systemctl restart network'.
What command should be executed to change the configuration file IP to a static server IP?
Execute the command sh /home/mdm_shell/ipconfig.sh and enter the static server IP accordingly.
Under what condition should Step 8 be performed, and what script is used?
Step 8 should be performed only if Smart MDM needs to run on the Internet. The script used is sh /home/mdm_shell/publicnet.sh.
What is the consequence of installing both hardware and software dongles simultaneously, and which script installs the driver?
Installing both hardware and software dongles at the same time will render the MDM unusable. The driver is installed by executing sh /home/mdm_shell/hl_dongle.sh.
How do you add the dongle to the Linux system after uploading the local.v2c file?

The Device Task Workstation (DTW) automatically executes the tasks pushed by the Admin Client.

MDM 数据库内必须具备这些终端的 IMEI 号，同时还必须具备与这些 IMEI 号所关联的两个 License KEY。
在 Smart MDM 中，如何配置应用卸载名单以保护监控类应用不被卸载？
对于必须强制运行如监控类应用，可将其设置为禁止卸载应用名单中（即白名单）。
交互式安装与静默式安装在界面交互和用户操作上有何区别？
交互式安装/卸载会弹出提示或确认界面，需要用户操作（如点击“安装”或“确定”）才能完成；静默式安装/卸载过程无需用户操作，终端直接完成。
部署服务器端时，对操作系统、CPU核心数和内存的具体要求是什么？
服务器端操作系统需为 Windows Server 2008_64 位、Windows Server 2012_64 位或 CentOS-7-x86_64-Minimal-1611.iso；CPU 需 6 核或以上；内存需 16GB 或以上。
服务器端与管理端/用户端在磁盘空间和网卡速度要求上有何区别？
服务器端要求磁盘空间 1.2TB 或以上，网卡速度为 1000Mbps；而管理端/用户端要求磁盘空间 500GB 或以上，网卡速度为 100Mbps 或以上。
What are the supported audio file formats for this device?

The supported audio file formats are MP3 (.mp3), WAV (.wav), 3GPP (.3gp), MPEG-4 (.mp4, .m4a), ATDS raw AAC (.aac), MPEG-TS (.ts), FLAC (.flac), MIDI (.midi, .xmf, .mxmf), RTTTL/RTX (.rtttl, .rtx), OTA (.ota), iMelody (.imy), Ogg (.ogg), Matroska (.mka), QCELP (.qcp), RealMedia (.ra), Windows Media (.wma), and AC3 (.ac3).
What Mission Critical Services does the LTE-empowered MCS solution offer to Push-to-Talk users?
The solution offers Mission Critical Push-to-Talk (MCPTT), Mission Critical Video (MCVideo), and Mission Critical Data (MCData) services.
How much does programming time decrease for multi-mode hybrid terminals using Smart MDM?
Programming time is reduced by 69–96%.
Through which networks does Smart MDM transmit tasks to multi-mode hybrid terminals?
Smart MDM transmits tasks via 3G, 4G, or Wi-Fi networks.
How does Smart MDM control application installation and removal?
Smart MDM uses a blocklist formed from applications prohibited from installation and removal. Users cannot install apps from the first list or remove apps from the second list.
SIM 卡和 TF 卡安装在哪个部件中？
SIM 卡和 TF 卡安装在 SIM 卡/TF 卡卡槽中。
在组装过程中，关于FPC连接器和PORON有哪些禁止或确认事项？
需确认各个FPC连接器装配到位，没有虚接及不可靠连接；确认装配过程中不损伤FPC，板对板连接器安装到位；禁止随意更换连接器PORON，以确保预压可靠。
时钟方案中18.432MHz晶振的输出路径及接收组件有哪些？
18.432MHz晶振经过驱动芯片分别输出给处理器C6746、MCU、射频LMX2571 (U8006/U8007) 和射频AD9864。
U4指纹仪的识别精度是多少，通过什么接口与DSP通信？
识别精度高达508 DPI，通过SPI与DSP通信。
外部语音信号通过什么路径进入 codec，其后续处理方式与内部语音有何关系？
外部语音由 13Pin 接口通过 FPC 输入到 codec，入口为 MIC1L；进入 codec 之后，其处理方式与内部语音发送通路的处理过程一致。
除蓝牙模式外，信号的输出路径与哪种模式一致？
宽带模式。
发射信号在经过末级功放和微带线处理后，后续的信号处理路径是怎样的？
最后发射信号经过收发通路切换开关进入低通滤波器。
在发射路径中，完成阻抗匹配的信号经过哪些处理步骤后通过天线发射？
完成阻抗匹配的信号先经过收发切换开关，再由低通滤波器进行过滤并抑制谐波和杂散信号，最后通过天线发射出去。
4G DRX接收信号的天线配置及输入路径是怎样的？
4G DRX接收信号分别由低频分集天线和中高频分集天线接收，通过合路器Z9101后，输入信号至CAT4 ANT_DRX脚。
WIFI/BT信号的传输路径及辐射方式是什么？
WIFI/BT信号从XS9203通过射频同轴线传输至XS9204后，经由WIFI/BT天线辐射接收。
What are the steps to install a SIM card in the radio?

1. Use a Phillips screwdriver to loosen the screw on the SIM card cover. 2. Use a flathead screwdriver to remove the SIM card cover. 3. Use a flathead screwdriver to extract the SIM card tray. 4. Place the SIM card into the tray with the notch on the SIM card aligned with the notch on the tray. 5. Insert the SIM card tray into the radio. 6. Put the SIM card cover back in place, and then secure it with a screw.
How should the belt clip be installed and removed?

To install: Align the holder on the belt clip with the groove on the battery, and then press the belt clip downwards into place. To remove: Press and hold the spring plate on the belt clip and push the belt clip upwards to remove it.
Which mission-critical services are included in the MCS solution defined by 3GPP?
The MCS solution includes Mission Critical Push-to-Talk (MCPTT), Mission Critical Video (MCVideo), and Mission Critical Data (MCData) services.
MDM Pro通过哪些手段缩减常规业务耗时并提升效率？
MDM Pro通过并发操作、远程管控、定时下发等手段，大大缩减了常规业务（如写频、升级）的耗时。
单台MDM SE最多能同时连接多少台窄带TETRA设备？在执行写频和升级任务时有什么注意事项？
单台MDM SE最多可同时连接24台窄带TETRA设备。执行写频和升级任务过程中请勿断开设备与工作站(MDM SE)的连接。
在MDM Pro服务器上安装加密狗驱动前，应使用哪个用户登录？
应使用root用户登录MDM Pro服务器。
MDM Pro 专业版支持对哪些类型的终端进行批量化写频和升级？
MDM Pro 专业版支持对多模终端、窄带终端和执法记录仪进行批量化写频和升级。
MDM Pro 系统采用什么架构，管理员如何访问管理端？
MDM Pro 使用 B/S 架构，管理员无需安装管理端，在任意一台电脑登录浏览器即可对终端下发管控指令。
MDM Pro 服务器和工作站分别需要运行在什么操作系统上？
MDM Pro 服务器需运行在 AlmaLinux 9 上；工作站需运行在 Windows 11 64 位或 Windows 10 64 位上。
组织在资产管理中的主要作用是什么？
组织用于对工作站、设备或管理员进行划区分组。管理员仅能对自己所在组织的设备或工作站进行事务管理，以实现分组自治。
在增加管理员、工作站或设备之前，为什么需要先新建组织？
因为增加管理员、工作站或设备时，均需要指定其所在的组织，所以在增加这些资产前需要先新建组织。
集成设备工作站如何与 MDM Pro 建立连接？
通过 Internet 与 MDM Pro 连接。
在 MDM Pro 中配置工作站时，机器码的作用是什么以及在哪里获取？
机器码用于为工作站授权，需在工作站操作界面获取。
如何将获取自 Hytera 应用的插件上传至 MDM Pro？
登录 MDM Pro, 在左侧导航树单击 “系统维护 -> 插件”，然后单击 “上传”，将获取自 Hytera 应用的插件上传至 MDM Pro。
如何获取并上传 HP785 的写频插件到 MDM Pro？
首先向海能达技术支持人员获取 HP785 的写频插件。然后在 MDM Pro 左侧导航树单击 “系统维护 -> 插件”，单击 “上传”，将写频插件上传至 MDM Pro。
Which video file formats and their extensions are listed in the reference?

The listed video formats and extensions are: 3GPP (.3gp), MPEG-4 (.mp4), QuickTime (.mov), WEBM (.webm), Windows Media (asf, wmv), RealMedia (.rmvb, .rmv), MPEG-PS (.mpeg_, .mpeg), MPEG-TS (ts), AVI (avi), and Matroska (mkv).
除了远程批量管控和写频下发，Smart MDM 还支持哪些主要功能？
Smart MDM 支持终端升级、指令下发、功能和应用权限管控、密钥推送、设备健康管理、数据备份与恢复等多种功能。
海能达新一代移动设备管理系统的英文缩写是什么？
Smart MDM。
How are commands and their execution results denoted in the text formatting conventions?
Commands and their execution results are denoted by Courier New font.
What is the correct procedure for installing the antenna, and what precaution should be taken regarding handling?

To install the antenna: 1. Optionally place the color ring on the antenna connector. 2. Put the antenna on the connector. 3. Rotate the antenna clockwise till hand tight. Do not hold the terminal by the antenna, as it may reduce performance and lifespan.
How do you install a micro-SIM card into the device?
Pull the micro-SIM card tray out of the slot, place the micro-SIM card with the gold contacts facing up on the tray, and insert the card tray with the micro-SIM card back into the slot.
What is the correct procedure to re-install a micro-SD card?
Take the card out completely, and then re-insert it to the slot.
What steps are required to install the battery into the terminal?
Slide the battery into the slot and press the battery latch until it is fully fitted into the terminal.
What are the steps to uninstall an app from the apps panel?
Touch and press the required app icon until it jiggles, then tap X.
How can you enable the terminal to access private network services?
You can either swipe up from the bottom edge of any screen and tap Narrowband, or go to Settings > PMR > Narrowband and turn it on.
Which services can be enabled while in Airplane mode if permitted by the cabin crew?
If permitted by the cabin crew, you can turn on WLAN network or BT, or initiate NB services.
How do you enable LTE services to improve voice and other communications?
Tap Network > Enhanced 4G LTE Mode, and then turn it on.
What is the minimum battery power level required before starting a terminal upgrade, and what is the risk of ignoring this requirement?
The battery power must be more than 30% before upgrading. A power outage during the upgrade may cause terminal failure.
How can a user initiate a system upgrade on the terminal through the settings menu?
To upgrade via settings, tap Settings > General > System upgrade to upgrade the broadband system or narrowband system.
What are the recommended connection type and operational restrictions during a software upgrade?
It is recommended to use a WLAN connection to download the software, and users should not operate the terminal during the upgrade.
What are the steps for installing the antenna correctly?
First, optionally put the color ring on the antenna connector for identification. Second, put the antenna on the antenna connector. Third, rotate the antenna clockwise until it is hand tight.
How should the Micro SIM card be placed on the tray during installation?
Place the Micro SIM card with the gold contacts facing up on the tray.
What must be done before re-installing a Micro SD card?
You must completely take out the Micro SD card before re-installing it.
How can you uninstall a non-system app from the home screen?
Touch and hold the app icon, and then drag it to the Uninstall field.
What prerequisite must be met before accessing 4G network services?
You must ensure that you have installed the SIM card with 4G services enabled.
What services remain available when airplane mode is enabled?
In airplane mode, you cannot use voice or data services, but you can use services over WLAN network or BT, initiate narrowband services, and use apps that require no cellular data connection.
What communication capabilities remain available when Graceful Service Degradation Mode (GSDM) is enabled during weak signal or no LA availability?
When GSDM is enabled, the radio can still receive group calls, initiate or receive emergency calls, and send or receive emergency status messages.
How does an emergency service end by default?
An emergency service ends when the service initiator performs a long press on the preprogrammed Emergency off key (TK by default).
How can normal use be restored when a radio is temporarily disabled by the dispatch station or trunking system?
Request the dispatch station or trunking system to send a revive command.
Which technologies does the location service use to determine the radio's location information?
WLAN, cellular network, BT, and GPS.
Which font style is used to denote commands and their execution results?
Courier New is used to denote commands and their execution results.
What is the priority level of the Emergency feature when initiating an alarm service?
The Emergency feature has the highest priority, allowing initiation even when the radio is transmitting or receiving.
How do you initiate an emergency alarm service when the Emergency feature is enabled?
Press the preprogrammed Emergency on key, which is a short press of the TK key by default.
How can an emergency alarm service be ended?
The service initiator must press the preprogrammed Emergency off key, which is a long press of the TK key by default.
How can a user enable data roaming to access services outside their carrier's service area?
Tap Roaming.
What services can be used when the radio is in airplane mode?
You can use services over WLAN network or BT, initiate narrowband services, and use apps that require no cellular data connection.
How can you resolve the issue when the radio fails to detect the Nano SIM card or Micro SD card due to improper installation?
Remove and reinstall the Nano SIM card or Micro SD card.
What should be done if the SIM card fails to work or is out of service due to unpaid charges?
Make sure the Nano SIM card works properly or pay the charges.
海能达PTC760如何满足专网用户从单一语音通信向多媒体业务融合升级的需求？
PTC760在保证关键语音通信可靠性的同时，满足用户应用集成和视频对讲等信息高效传递的业务需求。它支持公共安全用户的视频对讲、视频实时上传，实现信息实时查询、语音和视频联合调度，从而提升警务效率，帮助用户从单一语音通信向多媒体业务融合升级。
PPS (Private Positioning Service) 的主要功能和应用场景是什么？
PPS 可以在终端无 GPS 信号或 GPS 信号弱的情况下提供安全、精确的位置信息服务。其应用场景包括可视化调度和室内通话定位等。
如何通过 PPS WEB 客户端管理终端对 PPS 服务器的接入？
可以通过 PPS WEB 客户端导入 license 来控制接入 PPS 服务器的终端数量，并授权终端接入 PPS 服务器。
PPS 服务器提供哪些服务并具备什么控制能力？
提供终端定位服务、控制接入服务器的终端数量。
PPS 服务器如何将基站、WLAN 或蓝牙设备的 MAC 地址转换为位置信息？
由终端上传 MAC 地址给 PPS 服务器，PPS 服务器将 MAC 地址换算为位置信息。
部署 PPS 服务器端和客户端分别需要满足哪些最低硬件配置要求？
服务器端需 16 核或以上 CPU、32GB 或以上内存、500GB 或以上磁盘空间、1000Mbps 网卡；客户端需双核或以上 CPU、4GB 或以上内存、500GB 或以上磁盘空间、100Mbps 或以上网卡，屏幕分辨率需 1280 x 768 或以上。
PPS 服务中端口 8080 和端口 2020 的用途分别是什么？
端口 8080 是 PPS 服务器端口号，固定为 8080；端口 2020 是终端连接 PPS 服务器的端口号，固定为 2020。
使用 UltraISO 加载 CentOS 7 镜像文件的具体步骤是什么？
在“本地目录”页签中选择操作系统软件包镜像文件所在目录，然后在“文件名”页签中双击“CentOS- 7-x86_64-Minimal-1611.iso”文件。
制作完启动盘后，如何在服务器上设置U盘为第一启动项？
启动服务器并进入BIOS，将U盘设置为第一启动项，保存设置后系统会自动重启。
What must be set up first if you want to use NTP during the CentOS Linux 7 installation?
You need to set up networking first.
安装进度条完成后，应如何处理启动 U 盘？
从服务器的 USB 接口处拔出

通过拖拽的方式将这些文件上传至服务器所在主机的 /home 目录下。

需要将 libaio-0.3.109-13.el7.x86_64.rpm 文件上传到 /home 目录下。
libaio RPM 包安装成功后，下一步需要执行什么操作？
安装成功后，需要重新执行 sh pps_manager.sh。

执行命令 unzip -d /home/pps-server /home/hytera_deploy_linux-amd64_v0.2.0.zip。
如何为 docker-compose 添加可执行权限？
执行命令 chmod +x /usr/local/bin/docker-compose。
配置服务器时需要进入哪个目录修改配置文件？
需要进入 /home/pps-server/server-1/conf 目录。
在配置文件中，assetAuthUrl 和 reportGpsUrl 应分别替换为什么地址格式？
assetAuthUrl 应替换为 http://服务器 IP:8080/ppsManager/terminal/checkDeviceSn，reportGpsUrl 应替换为 http://服务器 IP:8080/ppsManager/terminal/reportGPS。
服务器在网络规划中的IP地址是多少？
替换内容时需要注意什么以避免服务器地址错误？
替换的内容需与文件中其他行对齐，否则会导致服务器地址错误。
如何使用 Xftp 工具处理 /home/pps/dongle 目录下的 local.c2v 文件？
使用 Xftp 工具将 “/home/pps/dongle” 下的 local.c2v 文件拷贝到 Windows 电脑。
如何部署从海能达客服获取的 local.v2c 文件？
使用 Xftp 工具将 local.v2c 文件上传到 “/home/pps/dongle” 目录。
Which command is used to follow the logs of the Docker Compose services?
docker-compose logs -f
What is the directory path specified for navigation before checking the logs?
/home/pps-server/server-1
What status message indicates that the WAYZ Location Service is ready?
WAYZ LOCATION SERVICE READY v0.1.x
如何在 PPS Web 客户端中导入许可证？
单击右上角“admin > 许可证”，单击“导入许可证”，导入 PPS_License_xxx.zip。
如何通过 Smart MDM 配置多模智能对讲机以接入 PPS 服务器？
通过 Smart MDM 写频，将网络定位设置为专网，填写 PPS 服务器 IP 地址，并将网络定位服务器端口设置为 2020。
在高楼林立的 CBD 进行 PPS 验证时可能会遇到什么现象及原因？
因高楼遮挡，GPS 信号会不连续。
在使用 SSH 工具连接主机时，需要输入哪些连接信息？
需要输入主机名和用户名 root，端口保持默认值。
如何通过 SSH 工具获取 PPS 服务器的日志？
使用 SSH 工具通过 root 用户登录 PPS 服务器并获取日志。
PPS (Private Positioning Service) 的全称是什么？
Private Positioning Service
What does the 'Danger' icon indicate in the SMART MDM documentation?
The 'Danger' icon indicates situations that could cause major personal injury or even death.
What methods can users employ to encrypt the server and protect SMART MDM data?
Users can use software or hardware dongle to encrypt the server.
What is the primary function of SMART MDM Lite?
SMART MDM Lite is a lightweight system designed to control the radio.
What are the differences in template programming and firmware upgrade capabilities between SMART MDM and SMART MDM Lite?
SMART MDM supports batch programming for both template programming and firmware upgrades, whereas SMART MDM Lite only supports single programming for these features.
Which features are available in SMART MDM but not in SMART MDM Lite?
The features available in SMART MDM but not in SMART MDM Lite are File Management, OTAP, Remote Screenshot, Forced Lock Screen, and Data Erase.
How does asset management differ between SMART MDM and SMART MDM Lite regarding administrator accounts?
In SMART MDM, the super administrator and created administrators manage different services with clear permission classification. In SMART MDM Lite, there is only one administrator account.
What are the system capacity and concurrent processing limits for SMART MDM compared to SMART MDM Lite?

SMART MDM has a system capacity of 3000 radios and supports concurrent processing of multiple radios. SMART MDM Lite has a system capacity of 500 radios and does not support concurrent processing, handling only one radio at a time.
Which features allow users to manage emergency alarm services?
Emergency on allows initiating an emergency alarm service, and Emergency off allows ending the emergency alarm service.
What is the status of the RoIP network and voice services when the LCD icon displays 'P/D'?
The RoIP network is turned on, and the radio has registered voice services in the narrowband network.
How is priority level determined for groups when the Priority Group feature is active, and how does it affect service requests?

Priority levels are set to 1, 2, or 3, where a larger number represents a higher priority. When receiving service requests from multiple groups, the radio preferentially participates in the service of the group with the higher priority.
Why should you turn off cellular network services when they are not in use?
Turning off cellular network services when not in use helps decrease data usage and prolong battery life.
What services can be used while the radio is in airplane mode?
In airplane mode, you cannot use voice or data services. However, you can use services over WLAN network or BT, initiate narrowband services, and use apps that require no cellular data connection.
What is the behavior of the radio when the emergency alarm service type is set to 'Siren Only'?
The radio emits a siren but does not transmit any emergency signal to the control center.
How does the 'Silent w/Voice' emergency alarm service type differ from the 'Silent' type regarding audible indications?
In 'Silent w/Voice' mode, the radio gives an audible indication only upon receiving a call, whereas in 'Silent' mode, the radio gives no visible or audible indication at all.
Which emergency modes can be configured by a dealer if the emergency alarm service type is Regular, Silent, or Silent w/Voice?
The available emergency modes are Call Only, Alarm w/Call, and Alarm.
How is an emergency alarm service initiated and ended using the preprogrammed keys?
To initiate the service, press the preprogrammed Emergency on key (short press TK by default). To end the service, press the preprogrammed Emergency off key (long press TK by default).
What is the procedure to restore normal use if a radio is killed by the dispatch station or trunking system?
Send the radio back to the Company.
How can you uninstall an app from the home screen?
On the home screen, touch and hold the app icon, and then tap Uninstall App. Then tap OK.
What happens to the data and the device state during and after a factory reset via MDM Pro?
During the process, the radio displays 'Factory reset,' and all data including system, SD card data, and encryption keys are deleted. After completion, the radio restarts automatically.
Smart MDM V5.0 版本（2023-05发布）指导用户从哪个版本范围升级至哪个具体版本？
指导用户将 Smart MDM 从 V4.6.10.000 及以上版本升级至 V5.0.10.004。
Smart MDM V4.6 版本文档指导的升级路径是什么？
指导用户将 Smart MDM 从 V3.5.15.000 及以上版本升级至 V4.6.10.000。
MDM Pro 升级期间系统的可用性状态如何？
升级过程中，MDM Pro 将不可用，直到升级完成。
升级 MDM Pro 前，若浏览器曾登录过管理端，建议执行什么操作？

日志保留时间的功能是什么？
日志保留时间是清理日志的时间间隔，MDM会按该时间定期清除日志。
关闭管理端服务会产生哪些具体影响？该功能主要适用于什么场景？
关闭管理端服务时，管理员的所有业务将被停止，且当前登录的所有管理员将被强制下线。该功能主要用于系统插件升级时，防止管理员登录并修改数据库数据。
系统备份的数据具体包含哪些内容？
备份数据包括 Smart MDM 专业版软件数据及终端信息。
如何配置日志显示的时间周期？导出的日志文件格式是什么？
可通过设置中的“日志保留时间”配置显示日志的时间周期为近 7 天、15 天或 30 天。可导出当前日志列表中的所有日志信息，以 .csv 文件保存到本地。

Version R2.7_V1.0 was released in Nov 2019 and is described as the Initial release.

What are the minimum system requirements for the MDM Server in Smart MDM?
The MDM Server requires CentOS-7-x86_64-Minimal-1611.iso as the operating system, a hexa-core CPU or above, 16GB memory or above, 1.2TB disk or above, and a 1000Mbps NIC.
What are the device connection limits during the Smart MDM free trial, and how can they be increased?
During the free 90-day trial, Smart MDM controls 50 multi-mode radios and 50 Broadband radios. You can import a System License to increase the device quantity and grant permanent usage rights.
Smart MDM 提供的本地备份机制是如何实现服务切换的？
本地备份在同一地点部署主备服务器，终端连接到虚拟 IP。虚拟 IP 平时映射到主服务器，当主服务器不可用时，虚拟 IP 自动映射到备用服务器，从而达到服务切换的目的。
异地容灾方案中，主服务器和备用服务器的业务处理状态及切换机制是怎样的？
在异地容灾中，主服务器和备用服务器实时同步数据。正常情况下业务只由主服务器处理，备份服务器不处理业务；当主服务器不可用时，业务自动切换到备用服务器上，实现对设备的不间断管理。
Smart MDM 主备服务器之间采用什么机制进行数据同步？
主备服务器之间采用 Unison 实时双向同步数据。
终端和 Smart MDM 客户端（web）通过什么方式访问服务器？
终端和 Smart MDM 客户端（web）均通过虚拟 IP 访问服务器。
Smart MDM 高可用架构中，基于 Keepalived 如何监测服务器状态？
基于 Keepalived 通过 TCP 协议实时监测服务器状态。
当主服务器不可用时，Smart MDM 如何实现自动切换？
当主服务器不可用时，虚拟 IP 自动漂移到备用服务器，由此实现主备服务器的自动切换。
Smart MDM 容灾方案支持哪两种类型的容灾？
Smart MDM 容灾方案支持数据级容灾和应用级容灾。
Smart MDM 容灾切换过程是否需要人工干预，切换时间是多少？
容灾切换过程无需人工干预，切换时间需 3 分钟。
Smart MDM 同地部署方案中，主服务器和备用服务器如何共用网络地址？
主服务器和备用服务器共用一个虚拟 IP。
终端需要配置哪些服务器IP信息？
终端需配置主服务器 IP 和备用服务器 IP。
当主服务器IP无法访问时，终端如何处理连接？
终端自动交替访问主备服务器 IP。
部署 Smart MDM 需要几台服务器，各自的角色是什么？
需提供 3 台服务器，其中两台服务器部署 Smart MDM，一台服务器配置仲裁节点。
主服务器和备服务器如何接入网络？
主服务器和备服务器均通过代理服务器接入网络。
主服务器和备用服务器的CPU具体型号及核心线程配置是什么？
主服务器和备用服务器的CPU型号为Xeon 6226，主频2.7G，配置为2C/24T。
仲裁节点服务器的硬盘规格是怎样的？
仲裁节点服务器配备100GB SATA 3.5英寸有线硬盘。
主服务器和备用服务器的网卡接口类型及数量配置如何？
主服务器和备用服务器配置有4个1GbE网卡接口和2个10GbE SFP+网卡接口。
主服务器和备用服务器的内存规格及RAID控制器缓存配置是什么？
内存为32GB RDIMM 2666MT/s；RAID控制器为PERC H730P，配备2GB NV缓存。
在工作站处理执法记录仪任务时，如果正在执行数据采集任务且有新的写频任务下发，应如何处理？
由于工作站处理任务的优先级顺序为写频 > 读频 > 数据采集 > 升级，若已执行数据采集任务时有新的写频任务下发，需重新连接执法记录仪与工作站才可执行此写频任务。
Smart MDM 专业版是否支持升级执法记录仪的蓝牙？如果不支持该怎么办？
Smart MDM 专业版当前不支持升级执法记录仪的蓝牙。如需升级蓝牙，请联系海能达客服。
删除用户时有哪些限制条件？
仅管理员可以删除用户，且可删除除 Admin 和当前登录用户外的其他所有用户。
KMC、MDM、SCK和TEI这四个缩写分别代表什么？
KMC代表密钥管理中心，MDM代表移动设备管理系统，SCK代表静态密钥，TEI代表终端设备号。
TCM与eHSS之间通过哪个接口相连？
TCM与eHSS通过Th接口相连。
eMME与eHSS之间的连接接口是什么？
eMME与eHSS通过Mh接口相连。
eMME与eXGW之间通过哪个接口相连？
eMME与eXGW通过Mx接口相连。
How should the antenna be installed on the PTC760 radio?
1. (Optional) Place the color ring (for identification purpose) on the antenna connector. 2. Put the antenna on the antenna connector. 3. Rotate the antenna clockwise till hand tight.
How do you reinstall a micro-SD card?
To reinstall the micro-SD card, completely remove the cards and then reinsert it.
Smart MDM Lite 提供哪些具体的业务功能？
Smart MDM Lite 可提供对终端的写频、升级、密钥管理、权限控制和应用推送等业务。
Smart MDM Lite是由哪家公司研发的？
Smart MDM Lite是由海能达研发的。
为解决写频问题，Main Module和Business Module菜单下的日志选项应如何设置？
将Main Module和Business Module菜单下的所有日志选项设置为Close。
What are the key characteristics of Smart MDM local backup regarding deployment location and switchover time?
Smart MDM must be deployed on two servers at the same location for local backup. The disaster recovery switchover takes about three minutes.
How does the automatic switchover mechanism work in a Smart MDM local backup scenario?
The Keepalived service monitors server status in real time. When the active server is unavailable, the virtual IP is automatically mapped to the standby server, realizing automatic switchover.
Which application scenario is suitable for Smart MDM local backup?
Local backup is suitable for scenarios with high requirements for business continuity but low requirements for system disaster resistance.
What role do active and standby servers play in remote disaster recovery to improve server safety?
In remote disaster recovery, active and standby servers serve as disaster recovery servers for each other to improve server safety.
What is the initial release date and description for version R3.5_V1.0?
Version R3.5_V1.0 was released in July 2020 and is described as the Initial release.
Which Smart MDM documentation guides are marked as updated?
The Smart MDM Operation Guide and Smart MDM_Installation and Configuration Guide_R3.0_V7.0 are marked as updated.
What is the effect of enabling Auto-Upgrade mode alone on radio management via Smart MDM?
With the Auto-Upgrade mode enabled, you cannot manage and control radios on the Smart MDM.
How can you simultaneously enable auto-upgrade and maintain management control over radios on the Smart MDM?
By enabling the Auto-Upgrade mode and the Enforced Management mode simultaneously, you can manage and control radios on the Smart MDM, and also enable the auto-upgrade of the radio.
How should the Smart MDM be upgraded from version V1.0.16.000 to V3.5.15.000?
You must contact the technical support engineers of the Company.
Which actions or services can trigger a Priority Interrupt?
Priority Interrupt can be triggered by an alarm, redefined button, stunning, all call, or short message.
What is the upgrade path for radios with versions earlier than V1.5.001 to reach V3.0.001?
Radios with versions earlier than V1.5.001 cannot be directly upgraded to V3.0.001. They must first be upgraded to V1.5.001 or V1.6.002 before upgrading to V3.0.001.
What are the differences between auto-upgrade mode and enforced management mode when setting the control mode?

In auto-upgrade mode, the radio automatically communicates with MDM and checks for firmware upgrades. In enforced management mode, MDM can conduct controlled operations such as sending messages and locking or unlocking the screen.
What actions are required if no dongle is detected on the Smart MDM server?
Log in to the Smart MDM server as the root user and execute the command to install the dongle. Additionally, insert the dongle that matches the license into the Smart MDM server.
CPS 软件的全称是什么？
CPS 的全称是 Customer Programming Software，即客户端编程软件。
What is the minimum efficiency increase provided by batch management in Smart MDM?
Batch management increases work efficiency by at least 69%.
Which access modes and application architectures does the SQL database in the storage layer support?
The SQL database can be accessed in Native, JDBC, and ODBC modes and supports both C/B and B/S application architectures.
What capability does the Storage feature of the information integration layer provide regarding heterogeneous databases?
It serves as a database that can read and store local data as well as data from heterogeneous databases, enabling two-way data read/write access to realize data exchanges between different systems.
How does the storage layer interact with Web Services?

The storage layer provides two-way support for Web Services. Data access and management can be configured as standard Web Service interfaces, allowing the service to read data from the storage layer to send to clients, and receive data from clients to write into the storage layer.
What happens when a token issued by the Smart MDM expires?
When the token expires, the device must go through the mutual authentication and verification to obtain a new token.
Which types of files can be transmitted between the device and NRM?
Commands and binary files, including applications, documents, firmware, CPS, policies, licenses, and encryption keys, can be transmitted between the device and NRM.
Which device peripherals can be remotely configured via Smart MDM to prevent information leakage?
Users can remotely configure the USB, TF card, GPS, and SIM card.
How does Smart MDM control application installation and uninstallation?

Application installation is controlled by the Install-disabled List (applications that cannot be installed) and Installable Apps (applications that can be installed). Application uninstallation is controlled by the Force Uninstall List (applications that must be force uninstalled) and Uninstall-disabled List (applications that cannot be uninstalled).
What are the two modes supported for application installation and uninstallation, and how do they differ in user interaction?

Application installation and uninstallation support interactive and silent modes. In interactive mode, notifications prompt during the process and users must manually confirm the operation to complete it. In silent mode, the application can be installed or uninstalled automatically without any user operation.
In which scenarios is the interactive mode for application installation or uninstallation typically applied?
Interactive mode is applied in scenarios such as application uninstallation, application installation through a browser, and application reinstallation through an application store after failure.
How does the Smart MDM ensure database security regarding key fields and what is required for its usage?
The Smart MDM can only be used with an authorized dongle. For database security, the tables and key fields are strictly encrypted to prevent data loss despite brute force attacks.
How are sensitive files like keys and licenses stored on the server?
They are stored in encrypted packages that cannot be cracked.
What determines the permissions granted to administrator accounts in Smart MDM?
Administrator accounts are managed based on roles, with different roles granted different permissions. Additionally, permissions for special features require extra licenses.
Under what condition can a device connect via PC connection verification?
The device can only be connected to the Smart MDM Lite installed on a PC that is in the white list.

通过 Internet 与 Smart MDM 连接。

首先在左侧导航树单击“系统维护 -> 插件”，然后单击“上传”，将写频插件上传至 Smart MDM。
What are the supported video file types?

The supported video file types are 3GPP (.3gp), MPEG-4 (.mp4), QuickTime (.mov), WEBM (.webm), Windows Media (.asf, .wmv), RealMedia (.rmvb, .rm), MPEG-PS (.mpg, .mpeg), MPEG-TS (.ts), AVI (.avi), and Matroska (.mkv).
What remote management features are available through Smart MDM for the PDC760?
Smart MDM provides features such as remote firmware upgrades, multi-command, feature and application permissions, over-the-air wipe and lock capability, and data backup and recovery.
What types of customized apps can airport professionals install on the PDC760, and what paths do these apps use?
Airport professionals can install customized apps such as W/O, flight check, and airline dispatching. These apps use both narrowband and broadband paths to increase productivity.

What configuration requirements must the standby server meet before performing redundancy deployment for MDM Pro?
The standby server's configuration must match the active server, and its operating system and MDM Pro must be installed.
In a distributed deployment where the active server includes one base server, one MySQL server, and one request server, what should the standby server include?
The standby server should also include one base server, one MySQL server, and one request server.
How is the arbitration service configured in the 'application.properties' file, and what are the default settings if it is not required?

In '/home/nrm/service/disasterRecovery', open 'application.properties'. If arbitration is not required, leave 'arbitration.model' at its default value of '0'. If required, set 'arbitration.model' to '1' and configure the arbitration node server's actual IP address and port number '8909'.
How do you enable the arbitration service in the configuration?
Set arbitration.model to "1".
What are the steps to install and start the arbitration node service?

1. Copy "MDMServer.tar.gz" and folder "mdm_shell" to "/home" on the arbitration node server. 2. Decompress "MDMServer.tar.gz" using "tar -zxvf MDMServer.tar.gz". 3. Open "application.properties" in "/home/nrm/service/disasterRecovery" and set "server.node" to "1". 4. Run "sh /home/mdm_shell/master-slave-shell/start_arbitrationservice.sh" to start the service.
How do you verify that notify-tools is successfully installed on the active server?
Run the command 'rpm -qa | grep notify-tools'. If the output returns 'notify-tools-3.14-9.el7.x86_64', it indicates that notify-tools is installed.
When configuring password-free sign-in on the standby server, what modification is required in the ssh-copy-id command compared to the active server configuration?
You must change 'standby server ip' to 'active server ip' in the ssh-copy-id command.
What is the purpose of setting auto_increment_increment to 2 in an active-standby server setup?
It defines the auto-increment rules of the primary key, which aims to prevent ID duplication during active-standby server synchronization.
What are the steps to restart the MySQL service for a single-server deployment?
Run the following commands in order: sh /home/mdm_shell/stop_mdm.sh and sh /home/mdm_shell/start_mdmForNewpush.sh.
Which command is used to restart the MySQL service for a distributed deployment?
Run the command: sh /home/mdm_shell/mdm_start/start_mmr.sh.
What command should be run on the active server to perform MySQL synchronization?
sh /home/mdm_shell/master-slave-shell/synch_mysql.sh
Where should the system license files be uploaded on the standby server?
/home/nrm/service/mdm-baseservice/data/systemLicense
In a dual-server deployment with active and standby servers, which server should the radio be connected to initially?
The radio should be connected to the active server.
What actions can trigger the radio to automatically connect to the standby server?
Unplugging the NIC or shutting down the active server will cause the radio to automatically connect to the standby server.
Which command is used to restore the active server?
sh /home/mdm_shell/master-slave-shell/reset_monitor.sh

同一系统的各个交换中心以及移动台的 initial 应一致。

Smart MDM 向第三方系统提供基础服务、终端上报服务、反向代理服务、推送服务和 Web 服务的告警接口。

Visitors can view tasks, apply/import license, and set language.

The port of safe mode is 8085, and the port of common mode is 8083.

GET https://TrunkingOverCellular/userConfiguration/mdn/userConfiguration.xml HTTP/1.1

消息类型为 GET，协议为 HTTPS。

拒绝UE的组呼请求。

SIP(200 OK)消息

ePoC Server 会向 UE1 发送 Talk Burst Granted 消息，将讲话权授予 UE1。该消息定义应符合 YD/T 1648 的规定。
当 UE1 并入组呼且当前组呼中 UE2 正在讲话时，ePoC Server 会向 UE1 发送什么消息？该消息的作用是什么？
ePoC Server 会向 UE1 发送 Talk Burst Taken（讲话权占用）消息。该消息的作用是通知 UE1 当前讲话方为 UE2。
当 UE1 并入组呼且当前组呼中没有用户在讲话时，ePoC Server 会向 UE1 发送什么消息？该消息的含义是什么？
ePoC Server 会向 UE1 发送 Talk Burst Idle（讲话权空闲）消息。该消息的含义是通知 UE1 当前讲话权空闲。

ePoC Server向UE2发送SIP(MESSAGE)消息。

消息2为200 OK (UE 到 ePoC Server)。

pttGgUpdate 标识。

该消息用于指示系统主动鉴权成功，并携带 UE 身份码 MSAuthCode。

stun

revive

ePoC Server向UE1发送Talk Burst Revoke消息。该消息的原因码应设为4，表示讲话权被抢占。

ePoC Server分别向UE1和UE2发送Talk Burst Taken消息，通知它们当前讲话方为调度台。
ePoC Server请求强拆组呼时，向UE1和UE2发送的是什么类型的SIP消息？
ePoC Server向UE1和UE2发送SIP (BYE)消息。
UE1 和 UE2 向 ePoC Server 发送什么消息来表示释放组呼完毕？
UE1 和 UE2 向 ePoC Server 发送 SIP (200 OK) 消息。

标志头固定为 0xAAAA，命令字固定为 0xCCCC，版本号固定为 0x2200。
Which text convention is used to denote commands and their execution results?
Courier font is used to denote commands and their execution results.

Open the card slot cover, install the Nano SIM cards into the corresponding slots, optionally insert Micro SD cards with metal contacts facing down, and put the card slot cover back in place.
How do you initiate an emergency alarm service?
Use the Emergency on feature.
What services are unavailable when Airplane mode is enabled?
You cannot use voice or data services.
How do you end an emergency service?
Press the preprogrammed Emergency off key, which is a long press of the TK key by default.
How does enabling Graceful Service Degradation Mode (GSDM) affect radio functionality when the signal is weak or no LA is available?
When GSDM is enabled, the radio can still receive group calls, initiate or receive emergency calls, and send or receive emergency status messages. If disabled, the radio will be out of service.
What is required to restore factory settings if the screen is locked?
You need to enter the password before restoring the factory settings.
How should you troubleshoot a radio that cannot be turned on due to improper battery installation or dirty contacts?
If the battery is installed improperly, remove and reattach it. If poor contact is caused by dirty or damaged battery contacts, clean the battery contacts.

The packages MDMServer.tar.gz, mdm_shell, and sql must be uploaded to the /home directory.
What is the correct sequence of commands for backing up data, installing Smart MDM, and restoring data during the Linux Server upgrade from R4.6 to R5.0?

First, run sh /home/mdm_shell/46-50bak.sh to back up server data. Second, run sh /home/mdm_shell/mdm_install.sh to install the latest Smart MDM. Third, run sh /home/mdm_shell/46-50.sh to restore backup data.
When should the public network IP address be entered during the IP configuration step of the Smart MDM Linux Server upgrade?
The public network IP address should be entered only if Smart MDM needs to run on the public Internet.

该服务器的内存容量和硬盘配置分别是多少？
内存容量为16GB，硬盘配置为5块300GB硬盘。

支持5000台终端接入。
该服务器的电源规格和网卡类型有哪些选项？
电源规格为2个750W；网卡选项包括双口千兆网卡或4口千兆自适应独立网卡。

指导用户将 Smart MDM 从 V4.6.10.000 及以上版本升级至 V5.0.10.004。

建议按【Ctrl】键+【F5】键清除浏览器缓存。
本文档适用于将旧版本 MDM 升级至哪个特定版本？
本文档仅介绍将旧版本的 MDM 升级至 R6.0 版本。
MDM 服务器 R5.5 及以后版本支持哪些操作系统部署？
仅支持 Linux 部署。
如果当前操作系统不是 Linux，但需要部署 MDM 服务器 R5.5 及以后版本，应如何处理？
请联系我司客服处理。

MDM安装完成后，在新系统上应如何恢复之前备份的文件？
首先在新系统上创建备份目录“/opt/mdm_upgrade”，然后将之前备份的文件拷贝至该目录下。
What is the command to move the directory /home/nrm/service/mdm-baseservice/data to /home/nrm/service/mdm-baseservice/da ta_src?
mv /home/nrm/service/mdm-baseservice/data /home/nrm/service/mdm-baseservice/da ta_src
Which directories are recursively copied from /home/nrm/service/mdm-baseservice/data_src/ to /home/nrm/service/mdm-baseservice/data/?
wallpaper, rcdb, and firmware

/home/mdm_shell/upgrade-mysql-64 mysql-server nrm_database_temp
What command prepares the upgrade-mysql-64 script for execution?
chmod +x /home/mdm_shell/upgrade-mysql-64
